SELECT t_erp_materiel.id, t_erp_materiel.erp_materiel_showdesc AS erpMaterielShowdesc, t_erp_materiel.erp_materiel_no AS erpMaterielNo, t_erp_materiel.erp_materiel_name AS erpMaterielName, t_erp_materiel.product_class_no AS productClassNo, t_erp_materiel.product_class_name AS productClassName, t_erp_materiel.unit FROM t_erp_materiel WHERE t_erp_materiel.is_deleted = #{param.deleted}
AND t_erp_materiel.erp_materiel_showdesc LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.erpMaterielShowdesc}, '%')
AND t_erp_materiel.erp_materiel_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.erpMaterielNo}, '%')
AND t_erp_materiel.erp_materiel_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.erpMaterielName}, '%')
ORDER BY t_erp_materiel.gmt_modified DESC
